# Singularity

> Singularity Research and Development Inc. is a frontier AI security lab. With the owner's authorization, it hacks government systems, then secures them. It trains its own AI models, the Singularity Foundation Models, and builds seven products on them.

Key facts:

- Legal name: Singularity Research and Development Inc. Incorporated in Delaware, USA. Founded in 2024.
- Sister companies: Singularity Arge Siber Güvenlik ve Yapay Zeka Teknoloji A.Ş. in Türkiye, and Singularity Korea in South Korea.
- Founder and CEO: Muhammet Anıl Yağız.
- Hero line: "We hack governments. Then we secure them."
- All offensive work is done with the owner's authorization.
- Software the lab secured runs on 5B+ devices. 1B+ people use that software.
- 70+ peer-reviewed papers at venues like NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR and CCS.
- Vulnerability research credited by AWS, Google, Oracle, Intel and NASA.
- Pricing is quoted per company. There are no public prices.
- Contact: anil@singularityrd.com

The model:

- The Singularity Foundation Models are trained from scratch by Singularity. They are not a wrapper around another vendor's API.
- They run on-premises and fully air-gapped.
- Singularity Cyber finds weaknesses in your own network: internal pentest, vulnerability discovery and SOC triage.
- Singularity General is an in-house assistant for documents, analysis and code.
- Frontier Cyber is offense-grade. It is sold only to approved government and defense institutions.
- CyberGym, internal measurement: 88.0. Published results for other models: GPT-5.5-Cyber 85.6, GPT-5.6 Sol 84.5, Claude Mythos 5 83.8.
- DeepSWE v1.1, internal measurement: 77.0. Other models: Claude Opus 5.5 72.3, GPT-6.1 Sol 72.3.
- Singularity-3B is a small model. It scores 72 on Cybench, internal measurement.

## Company

- [Singularity homepage](https://singularityrd.com/): The lab, the model, all seven products, pricing and the FAQ on one page.

## Products

- [Singularity Foundation Models](https://singularityrd.com/#research): AI models trained from scratch by Singularity. They run on-premises and fully air-gapped, and power every product.
- [AutoSecOps](https://singularityrd.com/#autosecops): An AI security team. AI SOC analysts triage and investigate every alert, cases are written automatically, and AI SOAR workflows act with human approval. 300+ integrations and an MCP server. It also automates workflows for IT, finance, RevOps and other teams.
- [AIDR](https://singularityrd.com/#aidr): Security for AI agents. It watches what agents do at the operating-system kernel and blocks prompt injection, tool abuse and data theft. No code changes.
- [IT Ops](https://singularityrd.com/#itops): An AI on-call engineer. It groups alerts into one incident, finds the cause, proposes a fix, applies it with approval and records every step.
- [Breakpoint](https://singularityrd.com/#breakpoint): An AI pentester. It attacks code, web apps, APIs and AI apps every day, proves each finding with a reproduced exploit and delivers a fix.
- [Fennec](https://singularityrd.com/#fennec): A fast code security scanner. It finds vulnerabilities, leaked secrets, risky dependencies and quantum-weak crypto in seconds. 14 languages. Code never leaves.
- [Sonar](https://singularityrd.com/#sonar): Factory and OT network security. It shows what is happening on a plant network without stopping production.
- [RoboDR](https://singularityrd.com/#robodr): Security for robots. It sees an attack, stops the robot safely and proves what happened. It supports ROS 2 robots.
